violation_type.title: Arrangement of Napping Equipment - Not Blocking Entrances or Exits (26 TAC §746.2909(1))
violation_type.short_title: Arrangement of Napping Equipment - Not Blocking Entrances or Exits
violation_type.typical_finding: A cot was observed to be blocking the exit door in a classroom. This was corrected at inspection when the caregiver removed the cot from in front of the door.

finding_variants.text: A cot was observed to be blocking the exit door in a classroom. This was corrected at inspection when the caregiver removed the cot from in front of the door.
Three classooms had napping children in the exit paths of classrooms.  The violation was corrected at the time of inspection.
A child was sleeping on the nap mat in front of the exit door.
Infant's crib with napping infant in the 0-12 Month classroom was placed by the exit door.

This standard was found to be deficient due to sleeping mats obstructing the exit/entrance door. During the inspection caregivers promptly corrected the issues by relocating the mats away from the door.
Five classrooms were observed with children napping in the exit walkway.    This was corrected at inspection when each caregiver of the classes moved the children to another location.
